title: The Cord-Master's Course
summary: A course that moves the binder from simple knots to cords that follow a foe's moving limb.

title: Handbook of Linked Pairs
summary: A handbook on linking two beings or two foes by one line so that what strains one is felt by the other.

title: The Shared Burden Workbook
summary: A workbook on tying a burden between allies so a hurt or a weight is carried by two and sent back to the cause.

title: Treatise on the Drawn Line
summary: A treatise on lines drawn across a foe's path and the nets they close into when many are drawn together.

title: The Binding Between Two
summary: A study of the bond that runs between two beings whether allies or foes and how to hold or lock it.

title: A Course in Unpicking Knots
summary: A course in reading a hostile binding and taking it apart without harm to the one who wears it.

title: The Anchor and Line Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book of anchors fixed to heavy things and lines run from them to hold a foe or haul a friend.
